title: Candlelit Gathering
description: A large purple dripping candle with a glowing flame stands atop a hill under a swirling purple and green night sky containing a luminous full moon. In the foreground and midground, a crowd of small blue hooded creatures faces the candle, many holding glowing orbs, while bubbles float throughout the surreal scene framed by an ornate, cracked border.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a giant melting purple candle with dripping wax and bright flame standing on a hill under a swirling purple and green sky with a large glowing moon. A large crowd of small blue hooded creatures with round bodies stands in the foreground and on stairs watching the candle, many holding luminous orbs. Translucent bubbles float everywhere. The entire image is contained within an ornate cracked wooden frame with teal and gold tones, atmospheric and mystical lighting.
